reviews.comment: Prof. Smith's class was extremely easy. The exams had a bunch of joke answers and could be figured out using common sense. His lectures were kind of boring, but the notes were good. Attendance is mandatory. It won't affect your grade too much if you don't go, though. He gives extra credit sometimes. I would absolutely take him again.

Edward is a great sociology professor. I took this class online so I don't know about attendance, but the class was really just listening to lectures and reading slides and the textbook. There is extra credit of 2% on your final grade, and he allows some AI usage on the course paper. Tests were easy with MC, T/F, and a few short answer.

LOVE this prof! Notes are easy and there's lots of anecdotes (he's hilarious). Fair warning that he can be profane. Exams are as straightforward as they come and there's two lightly graded essays. Extra credit offered. This class is a breeze so just try to enjoy it. DEF take if you need soci credit (I took it for my behavioral science credit)

If you need to take sociology, take him. He is straightforward and very understanding. He gives out the notes you need for the exam. He won't make trick questions. No quizzes. Very few assignments. He is really funny and can use profane language sometimes. Two essays graded lightly.

One of the best and easiest professors I've ever had. The exams are extremely easy and will tell you what information you need to know before. His lectures go by fast and sometimes even lets you out early. He responds to emails every fast and cares about his students a lot. Would recommend him to anyone who needs sociology.

Mr. Smith was one of the best professors I've had due to his sarcasm and sense of humor. He was entertaining throughout his lectures, and very real. I really recommend him for Intro to SOCI!! You won't regret it!

His class is extremely easy, and it is also easy to make an A. He also takes attendance, so try and be there. The exams are extremely easy, and he always reviews beforehand. He also provides a few extra credit opportunities.

He is the best professor I've had and actually cares about his students. I actually liked going to his class because he made his lectures interesting, relevant, and funny. You'll be fine if you look over the lecture slides before the test. Attendance isn't graded, but if you miss more than nine classes, you fail the course.

Professor Ed was one of the best professors I've ever had. He truly cares about his students success, and doesn't throw any curve balls on the exams. Three exams, no final exam, and he posts reviews of everything that you need to know for said exams. Texas A&M is lucky to have him!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: His class is super easy and fun, his tests are really easy if you take notes and had lecture slides posted if you miss anything. It's made up of 3 exams and a course paper and also attendance is required and a grade at the end of semester. He's really funny and is really understanding. I'd definitely take his class again.

Ed is amazing! Take him if you can! His passion for sociology shows in every lecture. His class is super easy & fun. He makes jokes & tries to make the material interesting and applicable to pop culture. As long as you study his lecture slides, the class is a breeze. A couple papers to write (he hates that), but they aren't difficult at all.

Professor Smith was a super fun teacher! I took his class to fulfill a core curriculum class, and it payed off. This class is perfect if you are looking for an easy A that is actually interesting. There is literally no homework, and the two papers he assigned us were clearly outlined and easy to complete. Do yourself a favor and take this class!

Professor Smith is awesome, if you need a social and behavioral science, take this class. He really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He loves dark humor and his lectures are hilarious. 3 exams and 2 writing assignments make up your whole grade but he makes them simple and easy. Pay attention in class and you'll make an easy A.

Prof. Smith is the GOAT, if you have to take any form of sociology make sure he is teaching the class. Lectures are fun and enjoyable and he makes his material very easy to learn. In order to do good on the exams you must pay attention to the lectures, but he makes them simple enough that if as long as you listen and study you will pass with an A.

Smith has been a fantastic professor this year. He cares about his students, has good lectures, and he's really funny too. He loves South Park so expect to see some clips from that to illustrate some ideas. 100% would take his class again, it was fairly easy, he doesn't try to trick you on exams, and he gives you all you need to know.
